design_urea_tpy.source: Constructed: 1,575 t/day contractual plate times 365 days

ammonia_per_urea.source: Constructed: FY2024/25 ammonia output divided by FY2024/25 urea output, both from the auditor's product cost table

export_tonnes_FY2425.source: Constructed: note 20 export revenue divided by the auditor's disclosed average export price of US$385/t at an average rate of 49.0 — reconciles to 350.3kt

usd_egp_avg_FY2425.source: Constructed: the rate that reconciles note 20 export revenue to the disclosed export price and the implied export tonnage

subsidised_tonnes_FY2425.source: Constructed: the auditor's 147kt delivered over fourteen months, annualised

gas_share_of_materials.source: Constructed and FLAGGED: the statements give a single materials line and do not split gas from the rest. Gas is set at three quarters of that line, which implies 1,292 m3 per tonne of ammonia — inside the auditor's own disclosed 1,025 to 1,771 range. This is the largest modelled allocation in the study.

gas_realised_usd_mmbtu.source: Constructed: the company's own Q1 disclosure values 31,313,235 m3 of lost gas at EGP 251m, or EGP 8.016/m3, which converts to about US$4.68/mmBtu at the prevailing rate — below the US$5.75 contract price, which the study carries as its downside case

nh3_per_t_an.source: Ammonia per tonne of ammonium nitrate through the nitric-acid route plus direct neutralisation

anna_nameplate.source: Constructed and FLAGGED: no filing states the new plant's capacity. It is the ammonia design plate less the draw of urea at ITS design plate, converted at the ratio above.

dio.source: Constructed: FY2024/25 inventory over cost of sales

dpo.source: Constructed: FY2024/25 payables over cost of sales

kd_usd_nominal.source: Constructed: EGP 1,338.0m of FY2024/25 interest on a mean dollar balance of about US$233m

expected_depreciation.source: Constructed: the central bank's 7% inflation target against about 2.4% in the United States. The SAME wedge drives the currency path in the revenue build, so the two cannot diverge.

kd_local.source: Constructed: EGP 96,896,001 of interest on the EGP 500,000,000 holding-company facility drawn in FY2024/25 — the company's own latest local borrowing

real_rate_lt.source: Long-run emerging-market real policy rate, used to build the terminal risk-free rate from its own components rather than from a spot yield

kd_usd_lt.source: Long-run corporate dollar cost of debt

roc_terminal.source: Terminal return on invested capital, which sets the terminal reinvestment rate as growth divided by return on capital

maint_capex_pct.source: Maintenance capital expenditure as a share of revenue. The pre-project observed run of EGP 42.5-81m was abnormally low on a newly built plant; 3.0% is the mature-plant standard. No guidance exists, so this is sensitised.

anna_cash_margin.source: Conversion margin on ammonium nitrate over its own ammonia feedstock

local_free_parity.source: Local free-market urea clears at about 90% of export parity, implied by the FY2024/25 note-20 local revenue net of the subsidised and nitrate legs

urea_util.source: Utilisation path. Audited output ran 586.4kt in FY2022/23 (2% above plate), 521.9kt in FY2023/24 and 513.4kt in FY2024/25; the path never returns to plate because the summer gas curtailment is structural.

export_usd_path.source: Export price path, mean-reverting from the August 2026 quote toward the cash cost of the marginal gas-based producer.

export_usd_path_bull.source: Upside export price path: urea holds nearer the August 2026 quote.

usd_egp_path.source: Currency path at 4.5% depreciation a year from the spot rate — the same wedge used to carry the dollar debt at local-equivalent cost.

subsidised_t_path.source: Subsidised delivery path. The company met 147kt of a 322kt requirement in the fourteen months to August 2025, a 46% compliance rate the forecast does not assume away.

subsidised_p_path.source: Administered subsidised price path from the EGP 6,000 cooperative supply price.

local_free_path.source: Local free-market volume path from the 37.1kt implied for FY2024/25.

an_path.source: Nitrate volume path, flat on the FY2024/25 combined granulated and low-density output.

other_rev_path.source: Merchant nitric acid, the ferrosilicon plant's rent and services.

abnormal_gas_path.source: Stoppage and abnormal-gas cost, decaying as supply normalises from the EGP 164.5m charged in FY2024/25.

cpi_path.source: Domestic inflation converging from the June 2026 print on the central bank's target.

anna_capex_path.source: Project spending path against the bank-approved cost and the observed pace: construction in progress moved from EGP 3,790m to EGP 5,654m over nine months.

g_terminal.source: Terminal growth set at the central bank's medium-term inflation target: nominal maintenance growth, no real growth assumed

anna_util_base.source: Project utilisation in the terminal year, central case

anna_util_bull.source: Project utilisation in the terminal year, upside case

plant_distance_to_port_km.source: Aswan to the Mediterranean export ports — the reason inland freight is a disclosed cost line of its own

urea_stock_shortfall_t.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (Central Auditing Organization, report dated 23 September 2025), auditor's report — shortfall between warehouse records and the physical count at Damietta

gas_m3_per_t_ammonia_modelled.source: Constructed and FLAGGED: implied by setting gas at three quarters of the single disclosed materials line; inside the auditor's own disclosed 1,025-1,771 range

local_sack_price_low.source: Egyptian press reporting of open-market fertilizer sack prices

local_sack_price_high.source: Egyptian press reporting of open-market fertilizer sack prices

stale_listing_share_count.source: A stale exchange listing document surfaced in search — recorded ONLY as a documented discrepancy; it predates the March 2024 capital increase and is not used anywhere

aggregator_share_count.source: A widely visible market page, inconsistent with its own market-capitalisation figure by a factor of ten — recorded ONLY as a documented discrepancy, not used

prod_urea_FY2223.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2023 (Central Auditing Organization with PKF Rashed Badr & Co, report dated 8 October 2023), auditor's product cost table

prod_urea_FY2324.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2024 (Central Auditing Organization, report dated 23 October 2024), auditor's product cost table

amort_FY2223.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2023 (Central Auditing Organization with PKF Rashed Badr & Co, report dated 8 October 2023), amortisation of intangible assets
amort_FY2223.note: Modelled split of the depreciation and amortisation charge; flagged

amort_FY2324.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2024 (Central Auditing Organization, report dated 23 October 2024), amortisation of intangible assets
amort_FY2324.note: Modelled split of the depreciation and amortisation charge; flagged

an_price_egp_t_FY2425.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (Central Auditing Organization, report dated 23 September 2025), note 20 local revenue less the subsidised and free-market urea legs, over the combined nitrate tonnage

other_rev_FY2425.source: Audited financial statements, year ended 30 June 2025 (Central Auditing Organization, report dated 23 September 2025), note 20 — merchant nitric acid, plant rent and services

local_free_tonnes_FY2425.source: Constructed: note 20 local revenue less the subsidised leg, divided by the implied free-market price

local_free_price_FY2425.source: Constructed: export parity at the FY2024/25 realised price and rate, times the 90% local clearing ratio

usd_egp_anna_approval.source: The rate prevailing when the project cost was approved on 25 June 2025, used to state the dual-currency approved cost as one figure

anna_winddown_cost.source: Capital-discipline case only: the cost of stopping the programme in the first forecast year — contract settlement and site preservation. No filing states it; it is the study's estimate and is flagged.

q4_runrate_haircut.source: The fourth quarter of FY2025/26 is run-rated on the third quarter's revenue with a 3% haircut for the summer gas curtailment the company discloses every year

bs_gross_fixed_M9FY2526.source: Interim statements, nine months ended 31 March 2026, limited review dated 20 May 2026, note 6 fixed assets at cost

bs_acc_dep_M9FY2526.source: Interim statements, nine months ended 31 March 2026, limited review dated 20 May 2026, note 6 accumulated depreciation

spot_price_date.source: Egyptian Exchange closing session used as the study's anchor date

dimson_sum_beta.source: Dimson sum-beta over one lead, the contemporaneous term and two lags of the same weekly regression — the thin-trading correction, carried as the beta alternative

g_terminal_alt.source: The alternative terminal growth rate: two points below the inflation target, which is negative real maintenance growth

prod_urea_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Nine months reviewed output extended on the fourth-quarter run rate, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

subsidised_t_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Subsidised deliveries for the study year on the revised quota schedule, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

local_free_t_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Free-market volume for the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

export_usd_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Study-year export price: the auditor's disclosed first-quarter increase of 43% on the FY2024/25 realised price, moderated toward the forward curve, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

usd_egp_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Average rate across the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

subsidised_p_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Administered price for the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

local_free_p_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Free-market price for the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

an_t_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Nitrate output for the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail

other_rev_FY2526E.source: Constructed for the FY2025/26 bridge year: Other revenue for the study year, from the nine-month reviewed accounts and the disclosed quarterly detail
